```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(readr)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
```

# data

```{r}
data <- read_csv("/Users/zosiamikolajczak/ANL/ANL_inharmonic_melodies/results/results.csv")
```


# models | nofilter
## A - acoustic
```{r}
data_A <- data %>% filter(model == "A") %>% filter(filter == "nofilter")

formula_A <- c("r ~ cond * group + (1|pid)")
formula_A_0 <- c("r ~ (1|pid)")
formula_A_01 <- c("r ~ cond + (1|pid)")
formula_A_02 <- c("r ~ group + (1|pid)")

m1_A <- lmer(formula_A, data_A)
summary(m1_A)
m0_A <- lmer(formula_A_0, data_A)
summary(m0_A)
m01_A <- lmer(formula_A_01, data_A)
summary(m01_A)
m02_A <- lmer(formula_A_02, data_A)
summary(m02_A)

# porownanie modeli
anova(m0_A, m1_A)

# anova modeli mieszanych
library(lmerTest)
anova(m1_A)
```

```{r}
data_A %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=group, y=r, fill=cond)) +
    geom_violin(width=1) +
    geom_boxplot(width=0.6, color="grey", alpha=0.2) +
    # scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, option = "rainbow") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
    theme_ipsum() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size=11)
    ) +
    ggtitle("acoustic feature") +
    xlab("") +
    stat_compare_means(
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.format")
```

```{r}
grouped_ggwithinstats(
  data            = data_A,
  x               = cond,
  y               = r,
  grouping.var    = group,
  subject.id = pid,
  point.path = FALSE,
  yab = "r",
  results.subtitle = FALSE,
  digits = "signif",
  ggplot.component = list(
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 0.1),
      breaks = seq(0, 0.1, 0.02)
    )
  )
)
```
